description: This file contains timer initialization and utility functions for ARM1136 architecture, including timer setup, delay, and tick count retrieval.

methods.name: timer_init
methods.description: Initializes and starts the hardware timer, setting up the timer control registers and resetting the timestamp counters.

methods.name: get_timer
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time since a given base, using masked timer values.

methods.name: __udelay
methods.description: Delays execution for a specified number of microseconds, using busy-wait loops based on hardware timer.

methods.name: get_timer_masked
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp, accounting for timer rollover.

methods.name: get_ticks
methods.description: Returns the current timer value as a 64-bit number.

methods.name: get_tbclk
methods.description: Returns the timer clock frequency in Hz.
